math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}\begin{gathered}u=-x\Longrightarrow x=-u\\(u,v)\longmapsto(-u,v)\end{gathered}\\\begin{gathered}y=f(- x)\ \xrightarrow{\text{向右平移 }2}\ y=f(-(x - 2))=f(- x + 2)\\(- u,v)\longmapsto(2 - u,v)\end{gathered}\\\begin{gathered}x_{1}<x_{2}\Longrightarrow 2 - x_{1}>2 - x_{2}\\\text{原图从左往右上升}\Longrightarrow\text{新图从左往右下降}\end{gathered}\end{gathered}$$
